crossrefs.text: Teach them to your children, speaking about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
Jesus spoke all these things to the crowds in parables. He did not tell them anything without using a parable.
So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: “I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden since the foundation of the world.”
One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—
They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds, and I will declare Your greatness.
If only they had such a heart to fear Me and keep all My commandments always, so that it might be well with them and with their children forever.
Tell it to your children; let your children tell it to their children, and their children to the next generation.

Only be on your guard and diligently watch yourselves, so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen, and so that they do not slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and grandchildren.
